No two independent sources agree on 'easy Class 3, minimal exposure' vs 'exposed 4th class', so neither side is changed.

The park's Reflection Lakes page says Stevens Canyon Road is typically open late June-September; a regional visitor page says the lakes are drivable from Memorial Day weekend; a park opening-schedule release for 2015 opened the road to Snow Lake on May 1 and the full road May 22. The opening varies by snow year and the sources disagree on the typical date.
The only distance figures found are for multi-peak Tatoosh days (5.9 mi / 3,520 ft) or the winter north-face approach (2 mi); no source states the Classic Route's own round-trip or one-way distance.
